additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0482482
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-GB SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Siemens UK
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Ass
et: MP / P8 170000964
Charger ID / Serial No.:
HzydSa
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: Fast shutdown cable, KF13
Following the report, and after checking the charger, we see that the charger has errors regarding errorcode 3, and KF13.
See following:
First step to understand the real issue is to check the condition of matrix contactors to see if opening and closing was done properly and check all the FASTSHUTDOWN plugs.
It's necessary to confirm if no shutdown plug is connected in one converter that don't belong to that group and if the number of converters in each group match with SCB configuration.
Please follow the next steps to resolve the issue.
- Check the 24V, and see if it dropped. In case it dropped, please do the necessary to resolve this.
- If the 24V is OK. Please go ahead, and replace the Fastshutdown cable.  The necessary spare parts for this replacement are listed here below:
Also check the following step regarding the KF13 errorcode:
Check if the KF13 internet cable is connected correctly. If it’s not, replace the cable from KF13 to KF14. If the problem still persists, replace KF13 itself.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-GB SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Priscilla van Wettum
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
